children: said its board has approved the voluntary transfer of the listing of its common stock and two Qwest Corporation notes from the New York Stock Exchange to Nasdaq.
The securities include Qwest Corporation’s 6.500% Notes due 2051
Lumen and Qwest have filed applications to list the securities on Nasdaq and plan to file Form 25 with the SEC to complete the NYSE delisting.
Subject to customary conditions, the securities are expected to be delisted from the NYSE after market close on Oct. 5, 2026, and begin trading on Nasdaq at the market open on Oct. 6, 2026.
Lumen’s common stock will continue trading under the LUMN ticker, while the Qwest notes will retain the CTGG and CTHH symbols.
is not expected to affect the company’s operations, financial condition, or reporting obligations, and shareholders will not be required to take any action in connection with the transfer.

title: Lumen plans to transfer stock listing from NYSE to Nasdaq
